name: paymate_billing
description: PayMate Billing Engine - allows AI agents to instantly generate cryptographic, non-custodial invoices settled on the GOAT Network, and to monetize endpoints with the x402 Pay-to-Unlock paywall. Requires an API key (mint one at https://paymateagent.xyz/developers) sent as 'Authorization: Bearer pm_...'.
author: PayMate Team

tools.name: generate_invoice
tools.description: Generate a professional invoice for a client and return a verifiable payment link. The response includes payUrl (web checkout) and tgMiniAppUrl (Telegram Mini App checkout — pay on-chain USDC on GOAT Network) — send the tgMiniAppUrl when the client is on Telegram, otherwise payUrl.

title.description: The title of the service or product provided.

description.description: A detailed breakdown of the deliverables.

amountUsd.description: The total amount due in USDC.

freelancerWallet.description: The crypto wallet address (0x...) of the agent or freelancer receiving the funds.

clientWallet.description: The crypto wallet address (0x...) of the client paying the invoice. If unknown, use '0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000'.

tools.name: create_paywalled_invoice
tools.description: Create a paywalled invoice for a premium endpoint or digital product and receive the x402 quote (accepts[]). Pass the deliverable in 'content' and PayMate stores it server-side and serves it at pageUrl once the payment is verified. Present the payUrl (or tgMiniAppUrl for clients on Telegram — on-chain USDC on GOAT Network inside the Mini App) to your client; when they pay USDC on GOAT Network, unlock by retrying with the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header (base64 JSON {"txHash":"0x..."}). Try it at https://paymateagent.xyz/paywall.

title.description: The name of the premium resource being gated.

description.description: What the client gets after paying.

freelancerWallet.description: The wallet address that receives the payment.

clientWallet.description: Optional. The expected paying wallet; omit for an open invoice.

content.description: Optional. The deliverable served to the client after payment verification (stored server-side).
